text_block_list.name: Smartphone
text_block_list.text:
"Just as the buzz around the Prix de l'Arc
de Triomphe has quieted
down, we
received news that has sent us all into an
uproar!"

text_block_list.name: Smartphone
text_block_list.text:
"We're here to report that one of the
world's strongest racers will be
joining the
Japan Cup! Her participation is causing
quite the stir!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass! Nice to see you again!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Welcome home, El. I suppose our room will
be much noisier going
forward.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Nice to hear those biting comments
again too!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now I need to get used to Japan again,
and fast! After all, I was away
for over half
a year!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That's very true... There's the time difference, the food, and of course... studying. Returning to daily life is certain to be quite the challenge.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Aaaahhh! Studying is the one challenge I don't want to face!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course... you also need to reacquaint
yourself with Japanese
racecourses. We
still have our promise to keep, you know.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, originally you'd be racing against
the world's strongest racer,
but... I guess
there'll be a slight change of plans...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El... regardless of how you view that race, I
still saw your Prix de l'Arc
de Triomphe as
a magnificent race.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Even after running in such an important
race, I still see you the same
way... You
still encourage me to run as my rival... and
my inspiration.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That alone has me excited for this year's
Japan Cup. Naturally, it
serves as another
stepping stone on my way to the top,
but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It is also a chance for your Japanese
competitors to carve our names
in the
hearts of people the world over.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You better show 'em how it's done!
Let them see how strong
my rivals are!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It hasn't been long since Special Week
won the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've been hard at work preparing for the
Japan Cup, but it seems
that race had a
surprise in store for us.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"We will now move on to our interview
with the racer herself."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, it's starting!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
We hear you'll be heading to Japan soon.
Please tell us about that!

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: Yes, gladly.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
I have participated in races the world over,
and now, I have taken on
the pinnacle of
racing and won.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
However, that race also showed me that
this world is still filled with
talented
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
And I must admit... my interest was piqued
by these yet unknown
foes—by these
racers running in Japan's Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa may have lit this fire in me,
but I have heard much
about her
contemporaries, Grass Wonder and Special
Week.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
As they are both participating in the Japan
Cup, I too shall be taking
on this
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: <I hope you will look forward to it.>

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Who would've thought the Arc
Umamusume would come here.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: She even mentioned Spe by name...

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"Next up, we'll hear the fan reaction to the
news of Montjeu's
participation."

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"Her race with El Condor Pasa was totally
intense! Seeing just how
strong our
Japanese racers are really got my blood
pumping!"

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"Which made losing so much harder... But
that's why I want our racers
to do their
best in this next race!"

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"Special Week, Grass Wonder... If you're
watching, just know
everyone in Japan is
rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"As you can see, many fans are looking to
get payback for the Prix de
l'Arc de
Triomphe. They've thrown their support
behind our Japanese
racers."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The racing fans of Japan all know Montjeu
as the one who crushed El
Condor Pasa's
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the program regarding the Arc
Umamusume continues, Special
Week
simply watches on, her eyes never leaving
the screen.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Looks like we've got more training to do.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Looks like we've got more training to do.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Japan grows more and more excited
about the Japan Cup, we
receive news
that stops us all in our tracks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder has been forced to pull out
of the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Can you believe the sun is already setting?
Winter is just around the
corner.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Um... About the Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It seems I... went a little too far during
training.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
With all of Japan watching, this race was
bound to lead me to the
top. Not to
mention, it was a chance to take on the
one who beat El.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The racing fans of Japan want to see one
of their racers win, and I
wanted so
desperately to be the one representing
them.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Of course, I also wanted to run with you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Me?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Your performance at the autumn Tenno
Sho was simply amazing.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hearing we were both going to be in the
Japan Cup, I was naturally
very excited. I
couldn't wait... to run with you...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I really... wanted to run this race...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I promise, Grass...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wanted to race you too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wanted to beat both Montjeu and you. I lost our last race, after all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So I swear I'll win. I'll prove that I, Special
Week, am Japan's strongest
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And then, I'll be waiting for you at the
Arima Kinen... as the best racer
in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, in that case, I should recover
quickly so I can appropriately
prepare for
our race.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Please do your best in the Japan Cup. I
want you to show them just
how strong the
Umamusume of Japan are.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Show them how it's done, Ruler of Japan.
